description: Fixed-dose combination products. Maps a brand/trade name to its individual active ingredients so the cascade-detection and classification pipeline can reason about each ingredient (drug class, cascade membership) while preserving traceability back to the prescribed brand (e.g. 'Biktarvy → bictegravir / emtricitabine / tenofovir alafenamide'). Track-independent, like drug_dictionary.json: lives at kb/ root, not inside a PROD/DEV subfolder.

combinations.therapeuticClass_es: Corticoide inhalado + broncodilatador de acción prolongada (ICS/LABA)
